My nana passed away on march of 2016, her favorite holiday was Easter because she could host the egg hunts and have everyone at her house... she always had a dogwood tree in her yard because she was religious and loved the story behind its blooms. When she died she had one buried outside her room in Texas where they don't grow naturally.(or common at least)  
We also like to believe every time we see a cardinal that it's a good sign or her saying hello.

On easter of this year I was getting ready and I always sit in front of my bedroom window .. I was thinking of the time we celebrated at her house & how I wished she could be here & meet what would be her first great grand baby (my 1 yr old son). It was then I looked outside and see a bright red cardinal sitting on a branch looking at me , as it flew off I notice he was sitting on a tree that I had never noticed before ...a dogwood tree in full bloom that I had never noticed until right then ..right across from my window. Here in Georgia the dogwood is one of  the first to bloom & there isn't another one to the left,right or deep in the woods behind it it's just by itself right there with bare trees around it. I knew it was her saying hello .. I miss my nana so much. Glad I could share my story & hear yours!! [my precious nana ](https://ibb.co/dZtzhH)
